g.text: Does a larger environmental buffer change persistence?
Campaign 021: all 120 worlds. Initial food is identical; capacity is 24 or 96.
More storage changes resource retention and later trajectories; it does not isolate cap-loss mediation.
Finite-horizon outcomes do not establish permanent survival or a unique causal mediator.
